- Update for Minecraft 1.19
- Bundle required Fabric API components with the mod jar

This release adds support for MC 1.18.1.

For users interested in shaders, we recommend [Iris](https://irisshaders.net/) or [Canvas](https://github.com/vram-guild/canvas/). Optifine appears to work in some configurations, but it has issues making the experience less than ideal.

This release fixes compatibility with MultiConnect plugin. Thanks to @Earthcomputer

No other significant changes are in this release.

**Like with previous release, this release requires Fabric API 0.29 or newer.**

- Update for 1.16.2
- Fix issue where selection grid would move with the player within large selections
- Resolve some clipping issues with the chunk boundary view
